newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising to 10 the number of people executed there for drugs offences in the past month, the official Saudi Press Agency said.

It quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying the man, the fifth Pakistani to be executed in Saudi Arabia for drugs charges in the past month, was put to death by the sword after being convicted of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin.

The execution in the capital Riyadh brought to 46 the number of beheadings this year in the conservative kingdom which enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
